Format registry and identification, ported from formats.go.

Inputs are zero-copy cursors: matching only peeks indexed spans, so no rewind buffering is needed at all (the Go rewindReader disappears).

Imports

io, types

Types

CompressedArchive = ref object
  archival*: FormatHandler
  extraction*: FormatHandler
  compression*: FormatHandler
An archive compressed externally (e.g. tar.gz). Port of Go struct. 
Format = enum
  fmtTar, fmtZip, fmtGz, fmtZlib, ## zlib framing (".zz")
  fmtLz4, fmtBz2, fmtBrotli, fmtCustom ## user-registered format with its own extension
Closed set of built-in formats. Use this instead of extension strings: typos become compile errors, not runtime NoMatchErrors. Append-only: new formats go at the end to keep ord values stable. 
FormatHandler = ref object
  format*: Format
  ext*: string               ## e.g. ".tar" (canonical: formatExt[format])
  mediaType*: string
  kinds*: set[FormatKind]
  doMatch*: proc (filename: string; inp: Input): MatchResult {.closure.}
  compress*: proc (inp: Input; dst: Output) {.closure.}
  decompress*: proc (inp: Input; dst: Output) {.closure.}
  archive*: proc (ctx: ArchiveContext; dst: Output; files: seq[FileInfo]) {.
      closure.}
  extract*: proc (ctx: ArchiveContext; inp: Input; handle: FileHandler) {.
      closure.}
Registered format entry. Per-format settings live in the formats/* modules; the registry keeps closures bound to defaults. 
FormatKind = enum
  fkCompression, fkArchival, fkExtraction
IdentifyResult = object
  format*: FormatHandler
  compressed*: CompressedArchive
Exactly one of format/compressed is non-nil.

Consts

formatExt: array[Format, string] = [".tar", ".zip", ".gz", ".zz", ".lz4",
                                    ".bz2", ".br", ""]
Canonical extension per format. Single source of truth: matchers and CompressedArchive names derive from here, never literals. 
formatKinds: array[Format, set[FormatKind]] = [{fkArchival, fkExtraction},
    {fkArchival, fkExtraction}, {fkCompression}, {fkCompression},
    {fkCompression}, {fkCompression}, {fkCompression}, {}]
Canonical capability set per format. 
formatMediaType: array[Format, string] = ["application/x-tar",
    "application/zip", "application/gzip", "application/zlib",
    "application/x-lz4", "application/x-bzip2", "application/x-br", ""]
Canonical MIME type per format.
